The dish is a square plate, probably a side plate of about 20-22 cm. The carrots are cooked slices, roughly 12 pieces, covering a pile about 10 cm across.

Each slice is about 4-5 cm long, 2 cm wide and 1 cm thick, so about 8-10 g each. Twelve to fourteen slices come to roughly 110-130 g. Cooked carrots run about 40 kcal per 100 g, or perhaps 55 kcal with butter or glaze, which gives roughly 60-70 kcal.

I'll estimate 120 g and 60 kcal.
